case_title: Yogesh Singh v. Mahabeer Singh & Ors.
neutral_facts: The accused and the victim were strangers. The victim was carrying a gun and was heading to his house after taking a bath. The accused were clearing an irrigation channel. The prosecution's case was based on the testimony of the victim's daughter and other witnesses. The trial court convicted the accused, but the High Court acquitted them. The Supreme Court reviewed the case, considering the reliability of the witnesses and the evidence, and restored the trial court's conviction.
